title: Traffic-R1: Reinforced LLMs Bring Human-Like Reasoning to Traffic Signal Control Systems

claim.summary: Traffic-R1 trains language-model traffic control through expert-informed offline RL and online stepwise trajectory optimization, with asynchronous neighboring intersection messages.

modules.name: Expert-informed and online traffic-policy RL
modules.scope_reason: The LLM policy is optimized using expert actions and simulator trajectory rewards.

modules.name: Parity-scheduled intersection communication
modules.scope_reason: Position-based intersection groups alternate action/message phases to coordinate traffic signals.
